usage: Common noun for a bracelet worn on the wrist; in everyday Cantonese it is often used for metal, beaded, or decorative bracelets.
Works naturally as a standalone noun, and can also appear after numerals/classifiers such as 一條手鏈 or 呢條手鏈.
Very common in shopping, gifting, and fashion contexts; especially when talking about accessories, jewellery, or matching outfits.
For learners, note that 手鏈 is more specific than 手鐲: 手鏈 usually sounds lighter and more like a chain-style bracelet.
